title: Draft UK-US extradition treaty written in American English
summary: Gary McKinnon tells of Draft UK-US extradition treaty written in American English, about 2003 at United States (no place named), and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and it was written a British extradition treaty with America was written in American English

plain: Gary McKinnon, a British computer hacker who says he broke into US systems and found signs of a secret NASA space programme, faced a US effort to have him sent to America for trial. He says his lawyers noticed that the 2003 draft of the treaty for handing people between Britain and the US was written in American English, which to him suggests the Americans wrote it. He also points to records from the General Accounting Office, a US government watchdog agency, as part of his case that the process was stacked against him.
